payload.claim: The test name `test_a_seed_whose_fetch_fails_twice_raises_after_two_attempts` uses 'attempts' for the two seed executions, but CONTEXT.md reserves 'Attempt' for 'one numbered execution of a phase,' bounded on five axes and counted toward budget/no-progress — a meaning this seed retry (which runs before any phase and is not charged as one) does not carry. The docstring itself avoids the word ('reads', 'retry'), so this is confined to the identifier and is trivial, but it is the kind of word that invites a reader to conflate a seed retry with a phase attempt.
